segments.text: American Fork City Council — Regular Session — April 30, 2024:

Council Member Holley seconded Council Member Hunter’s comments. He stated he went down with Council Member John and Mr. Bunker. He appreciated all that Mr. Morgan has done to coordinate things and bring the community together to make them aware of the issue. He reiterated that this was top of their minds. Council Member Holley reported on the Arbor Day celebration was held last week, which was an amazing event where 16 trees were planted. It was a great experience, and great to get the community involved. The Beautification Container Gardening Class will be on Monday at the library at 7 p.m. Council Member Holley commented on the situation in Charlotte, North Carolina, where four law enforcement personnel killed. He expressed his appreciation to our emergency personnel and all they do for us.
